arStrings.szText: Purchased from the Altar of the Eldritch at the Tree of Whispers.

A deadly swarm of Firebats swarm enemies every {c_number}[SF_4]{/c} seconds, inflicting {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} total Fire damage over {c_random}{SF_7}{/c} total attack{if:SF_14}s.{else}.{/if}{if:SF_2} Enemies who suffer {c_number}{SF_11}{/c} attacks from {c_important}Firebat Servants{/c} are Stunned for {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} seconds.{/if}
Enemies are Stunned for {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} seconds after being hit {c_number}{SF_11}{/c} times by your {c_important}Firebat Servants{/c}.
